LanguageData.RR_SocialBodyTasteUnavailableExplanation: No social taste is currently available. Preferred own size remains separate.
LanguageData.RR_SocialBodyTasteInactive: Body opinions are currently inactive for this pawn. They apply between living adults with food metabolism who can have ordinary social thoughts.
LanguageData.RR_SocialBodyTasteAppearanceSuppressed: This pawn does not care about others' appearance, so their personal body opinion contributes nothing. Their stored taste stays the same.
LanguageData.RR_SocialBodyTasteAbundance: Embodied Abundance makes the opinion of a qualifying larger adult body at least +5. This cultural approval keeps stronger personal approval and does not change the stored taste or preferred own size.
